data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to play streaming audio with background support and lock screen controls.
data.what_it_does: A plugin to play streaming audio content (such as MP3, AAC, HLS) with background audio support and lock screen controls. It provides static methods for playback control, metadata streaming, custom metadata setup, navigation controls, and a real-time audio visualizer widget.
use_when: Building an internet radio application that streams audio from URLs.
Needing background playback and lock screen media controls on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: Needing advanced local file playback management with complex playlist structures.
Working under environments that restrict CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 licenses.
strengths: Built-in support for background audio playback and lock screen controls.
Includes streaming metadata parsing (ICY metadata) and artwork lookup options.
Provides a built-in `RadioVisualizer` widget with fallback animations.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on static methods which might limit certain architectural patterns.
data.setup_notes: Add UIBackgroundModes (audio, processing) and optional NSAppTransportSecurity exceptions to Info.plist on iOS.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a feature-rich, highly customizable audio player supporting multiple sources, looping, clipping, and precise position control.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a simpler, multi-platform audio player plugin suited for playing simple audio files or streams.
